value.sell_summary: Over the last 13 weeks you sold 26,023 transactions at an average basket of £6.05, delivering £157,469 in revenue across ~286 transactions per day. Top revenue drivers are Filter Coffee (£44,612) and Iced Matcha Latte (£29,546), with Iced Matcha Latte showing the strongest growth (up 27.9%). Miso Banana Loaf has fallen 21.9%. Only 8.2% of matcha transactions included a treat, representing about £207 of weekly untapped revenue. The opportunity is clear: push the matcha-plus-snack pairings and keep iced matcha as the star item to sustain growth.
